name: xhostd
description: Deploy websites, APIs, and services to xhostd from your coding agent. Create apps, push code, deploy previews or production, inspect status, and manage channels, environment, storage, and domains.

interface.longDescription: Use xhostd from Codex to create apps, push code, deploy previews or production, inspect runtime status and logs, and manage channels, environment variables, storage, domains, and other hosting resources through an OAuth-authenticated MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Create a preview for this branch on xhostd
Check my xhostd apps and deployment status

positive.description: The user asks for the live URL of an existing app.
positive.prompt: List my xhostd apps and give me the live URL of review-site.
positive.expected_behavior: Names review-site and gives its HTTPS hostname, read from the channel object.

positive.description: The user creates a new static site and puts it online.
positive.prompt: Using xhostd, create a static app called hello-review with a one-page site that says Hello, and put it online.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the app. Commits index.html with commit_files. Deploys the returned sha. Polls get_logs until the status is success. Returns the URL.

positive.description: The user edits a page of an existing app and redeploys it.
positive.prompt: On xhostd, change the heading on review-site to 'Updated by the reviewer' and redeploy it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the page, changes the heading with commit_files edits, deploys the commit, and confirms that the deploy succeeded.

positive.description: The user adds a secret to an app without sharing its value in the chat.
positive.prompt: On xhostd, add a secret named API_KEY to review-site.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the console link with the key filled in. Never asks for the value in the chat.

positive.description: The user connects a custom domain to an app.
positive.prompt: On xhostd, connect the domain shop.example.com to review-site.
positive.expected_behavior: Relays the DNS records word for word, and tells the user to ask for verification once the records exist.

negative.description: The request is unrelated to hosting, so the plugin does not trigger.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon next Tuesday.

negative.description: The user asks for a secret value, which no tool returns.
negative.prompt: Show me the value of the API_KEY secret on review-site.

negative.description: The user asks for a plan change and a payment, which the plugin does not make.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my xhostd plan and pay with my card.

publication.release_notes: xhostd for ChatGPT and Codex: create apps, commit code, deploy to HTTPS URLs, read logs, and manage environment variables, secrets, and custom domains.
